shipping.body:
This policy explains how Casify processes and ships orders.

Order Processing

Orders typically leave our fulfillment location in the United States within 1–2 business days of purchase, Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. You'll receive a confirmation email once your order ships, including tracking information where available.

Free Shipping

Shipping is free on every order, with no minimum purchase required. Products fulfilled through Printify have an estimated delivery time of 4–6 business days after shipment. Other products have an estimated delivery time of 8–12 business days after shipment. Estimated delivery times for your order are shown at checkout, based on your delivery address and the products in your cart. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. The 1–2 business day processing period is separate from the delivery estimates.

International Shipping & Customs

We ship to a number of international destinations. International orders may be subject to import duties, taxes, and customs fees charged once the package reaches its destination country. These charges are the responsibility of the recipient and are outside our control.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with tracking information so you can follow its progress.

Lost or Delayed Packages

If your order hasn't arrived within the estimated delivery window, contact us at zouhir.mahjoubi@zmdesign.me and we'll look into it with the carrier on your behalf.

Contact Us

Questions about shipping? Email zouhir.mahjoubi@zmdesign.me or call +212 653 926 665.

1. Use of Our Site

You may use our site to browse and purchase products for personal, non-commercial use. You agree not to misuse the site, interfere with its operation, or attempt to access it using a method other than the interface we provide.

2. Products & Pricing

We make reasonable efforts to display product colors, dimensions, and details accurately, but we don't guarantee your screen will display colors precisely. Prices are shown in USD and may change without notice. We reserve the right to correct pricing or listing errors, cancel affected orders, and refund any payment already made.

3. Orders & Payment

When you place an order, you're making an offer to purchase, which we may accept or decline. Payments are processed using the payment methods displayed at checkout. We do not store your full payment card details.

4. Returns & Shipping

Returns and shipping are governed by our Return Policy and Shipping Policy.

All content on this site — including text, graphics, logos, and images — is owned by or licensed to Casify and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce or use it without our written permission.

6. Third-Party Links

Our site may link to third-party websites we don't control. We aren't responsible for the content or practices of those sites.

7. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Casify is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the site or products purchased through it, beyond the amount you paid for the relevant order.

8. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws applicable in the jurisdiction where Casify operates, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

9. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Changes take effect once posted on this page, so please check back periodically.

10. Contact Us

Questions about these Terms? Email zouhir.mahjoubi@zmdesign.me or write to us at centre sidi ghanem essaouira, 44000 essaouira, Morocco.

about.body:
Phone cases, with the details up front

Casify is an online shop for phone cases and accessories. Browse the collection and choose the available model, color, and style on each product page.

Find the right fit

Check your phone model before ordering. Product pages show the available options and details for each case. If you have a question about compatibility, contact us before you buy.

Shopping with Casify

Shipping is free on every order. Review our Shipping Policy for processing and estimated delivery times, and our Return Policy for return and refund information.

Need help?

For product questions or help with an order, visit our contact page. Include your order number when asking about an existing order.
